telegram.header: WESTERN UNION · NIGHT LETTER · 13 NOV 1933 · 11.48 PM
telegram.vo: Inspector Hart. Come to Sable Flat. The Marigold inquiry lied. Tell no one. C. Pryce.

title: THE MARIGOLD SILENCE

coleSky.speaker: Danny Cole
coleSky.text: Chief, I can't see the ground.

hartSky.speaker: Hart
hartSky.text: Neither can the ground see us.

coleLand.speaker: Danny Cole
coleLand.text: We're down. We're actually down. I'm never complaining about trains again.

hobbs.speaker: Walter Hobbs
hobbs.text: Mr. Pryce says he never sent for you, Inspector. He went white as a sheet when I told him you were coming.

pryce.speaker: Cornelius Pryce
pryce.text: To Marigold. May she forgive me.

captions.sky: Over the Nevada desert. Friday, 17 November 1933.
captions.landing: Sable Flat airfield, a little before dark.
